These programs are designed to attract bright minds from Pakistan, India, and beyond. With competitive selection criteria, applicants can secure financial support and a vibrant academic experience in Japan. Learn how to qualify, apply, and maximize your chances of success.

faqs.q: What are the most common scholarship application questions?
faqs.a: Common questions include why you chose your field, your career goals, and how this scholarship will help you achieve them.

items.title: Kyoto iUP: Undergraduate Scholarship for Pakistan & India Students
items.summary: The Kyoto iUP is a fully English-taught undergraduate program at Kyoto University, one of Japan's most prestigious institutions. It offers a unique opportunity for international students to study in a global environment without needing prior Japanese language proficiency. This program is highly competitive and attracts top talent from around the world, including strong applicants from South Asia. Graduates receive a recognized Bachelor's degree from Kyoto University.

Strong academic record with competitive grades in relevant subjects.
benefits: Access to world-class education at a top-ranked Japanese university.
